text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"CA","level":"state","category":"application_screening_fees","status":"in_force","title":"California application screening fee cap and conditions","requirement":"A landlord or agent may charge an applicant an application screening fee only to cover actual out-of-pocket costs of gathering information on the applicant (e.g., tenant screening or credit report costs) plus the reasonable value of time spent, and never more than $30 per applicant (adjustable annually with CPI from Jan. 1, 1998). No fee may be charged when the landlord knows or should know no unit is or will soon be available. A fee may be charged only if the landlord offers either (A) a first-come, first-qualified screening process with written screening criteria, charging only applicants whose applications are actually considered (inadvertent concurrent-submission fees refunded within 7 days, or applied to another unit at the applicant's option), or (B) a full refund of the fee to any applicant not selected, within 7 days of selecting an applicant or 30 days after the application was submitted, whichever is first. The landlord must give an itemized receipt (personally, by mail, or by agreed email), return any unused portion of the fee if no reference check or credit report is obtained, and give the applicant a copy of the credit report within 7 days of receipt. Landlords may accept a reusable screening report under Section 1950.1.","key_value":"$30 per applicant maximum (CPI-adjustable since Jan. 1, 1998)","coverage_conditions":"Applies to landlords (owners of residential rental property) and their agents charging applicants, including guarantors and cosignors, to rent a residential unit.","exemptions":"Does not preempt provisions or regulations governing the collection of deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs.","coverage_logic":{"covers":null,"exempt":null},"subject":"landlord","interaction":"Applies notwithstanding Section 1950.5; the fee is not an 'advance fee' under Bus. & Prof. Code § 10026 and is not 'security' under Section 1950.5.
